title: Group Antenatal Healthcare, Education, and Recovery
official: Group Antenatal Healthcare, Education, and Recovery
summary: The objective is to evaluate implementation strategies and effectiveness of group prenatal care for women in treatment for opioid use disorder.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria

* at least 18 years of age
* pregnant and less than 28 weeks of gestation at study enrollment
* receiving treatment for OUD
* no major antepartum complications
* capable of giving informed consent
* willing to be visited by research personnel for up to 12 months post-delivery.

Exclusion Criteria:

* inability to speak English
* medical complications of pregnancy which would preclude participation in group care.
